title: Full bifolio exclusion leaves no replicated hand fit and a seed-sensitive public diagnostic
statement: All pages and panels of each test physical bifolio (Q,B) were excluded before fitting word dictionaries, IDF, NMF, hand centroids and synthetic generator priors on paired public practice training pages. None of the five frozen strict candidate pairs has two independent training bifolia per hand. Under the separately frozen descriptive two-folio training floor, two pairs survive: f55v–f57r and f50v–f66v, both testing G:2 against H:1 and training hand5 only on F:1. For f55v–f57r NMF assigns hands correctly in all three fits in each edition. For f50v–f66v it gives 2/3 correct in ZL (margins -0.0357 to0.0295) and3/3 in Takahashi. TF-IDF centroids give correct assignments for both pairs in both editions. The planted 10% control gives18/18 correct NMF assignments per pair/edition; unplanted copying gives9–11 correct and0–3 ties out of18. These are fit/background repeats on one shared physical test geometry, not independent manuscripts or replications.
check: A confirmatory hand-specific test needs additional independently annotated hand5 training bifolia beyond F:1/H:1 and multiple physically disjoint botanical CurrierB test contrasts. Hand3 also needs independent physical support. Freeze complete-bifolio exclusion and matched layouts before estimating an effect. Address vocabulary coverage in synthetic controls with a prospectively declared method before interpreting calibrated tail probabilities. Current results establish feasibility and sensitivity only; submit no hidden-page fact from this geometry.
limitations: Zero primary eligible fits is lack of independent support, not zero classification accuracy or evidence against hand differences.
The two scored page pairs share their test bifolia and training sample; three NMF seeds and paired editions are repeated measurements, not extra units.

Botanical CurrierB and hand2/5 restriction excludes training data from other sections/dialects. The original four-folio modulo fold scheme is replaced by training-only complete-test-bifolio exclusion, declared before scores; this is not a pure accuracy comparison with original broad folds.

Some synthetic cases project one or both test pages to zero TFIDF vectors. All zero-vector counts and margins are reported; no controls were dropped or retuned. One nonzero test vector can still decide the two-hand joint assignment.
No lexical result for hand3, no causal separation of hand and physical writing block, and no hidden-page data or hidden seed were used.

plan.sample: Both public practice partitions; fit only practice training pages, paired ZL/IT, H/B, hands2/5, >=40 certain P words. Score only the registered strict three training-pool pairs and the two independent practice-evaluation candidates. Never use hidden split.
plan.split: For each candidate pair remove all training pages whose physical (Q,B) equals either test bifolio. Include neither test tokens nor other panels of either test bifolio in dictionary, IDF, topic basis, hand centroids, or generator prior. Preserve all line layouts.
plan.primary: Require >=2 distinct training bifolia per hand. If none eligible, report unavailable, not zero accuracy. Hand3 remains unavailable.
plan.diagnostic: Separately permit the original >=2 training-folios/hand floor; score both surviving pairs without interpreting as replicated evidence. Test pairs remain descriptive, with shared physical groups stated. Restrict model to hands2/5 botanical CurrierB.
plan.model: Reuse fixed source control code: rank5 TFIDF NMF, df>=3,300 train updates,200 test updates,fit seeds47,83,113, no tuning. Baseline: direct TFIDF cosine to normalized per-hand centroids.
plan.controls: Source G-self-citation seeds401..406 trained on eligible training-only pages; separately plant10% same-length hand-exclusive markers using source implementation. Fit dictionary, IDF and NMF afresh for each control. Report all outcomes and zero-vector diagnostics.
plan.stop: No tuning seeds, cutoffs, model rank or word features after scores. If fewer than2 primary independent training bifolia/hand, no confirmatory manuscript effect reported.

validation.physical_disjoint_assertions: Every model fit checks complete (Q,B) exclusion and no target ID in training.
validation.previous_control_reproduction: For f50v/f66v, all72 NMF synthetic margins (2 editions x6 backgrounds x2 scenarios x3 fits) reproduce the published P-L2-008 control values within their8-decimal rounding tolerance.

reproduction.usage: Extract all four Python/JSON files to one folder. From repository root set PYTHONPATH to repository, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 and OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; run python path/to/run.py. Standard library and numpy2.3.5. audit.py is used only for collect(), not its main().

"""Frozen public bifolio-exclusive diagnostics; all fit inputs are training-only."""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from vs import corpus,generators
import control
import audit

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def baseline(train,test):
    a,b=control.documents(train,test)
    means=control.unit_rows(np.array([a[[str(p.hand)==h for p in train]].mean(axis=0) for h in ('2','5')]))
    cos=b@means.T
    return dict(margin=float(cos[0,0]+cos[1,1]-cos[0,1]-cos[1,0]),features=a.shape[1],
                zero_train_rows=int(sum(np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)==0)),zero_test_rows=int(sum(np.linalg.norm(b,axis=1)==0)))

def main():
    tr=[p for p in audit.collect(0) if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','5')]
    all_rows=audit.collect(0)+audit.collect(1); by={p['id']:p for p in all_rows}
    pairs=[['f55v','f57r'],['f46v','f48r'],['f46v','f48v'],['f50v','f41r'],['f50v','f66v']]
    result={'plan':json.loads((HERE/'plan.json').read_text()),'geometry':[],'scores':[], 'numpy':np.__version__}
    for ids in pairs:
        ids=sorted(ids,key=lambda x:by[x]['hand'])
        held={by[x]['physical'] for x in ids}
        fitted=[p for p in tr if p['physical'] not in held]
        counts={h:{'folios':len({p['folio'] for p in fitted if p['hand']==h}),
                   'bifolia':len({p['physical'] for p in fitted if p['hand']==h})} for h in ('2','5')}
        geom=dict(pages=ids,test_bifolia=sorted(held),train_ids=[p['id'] for p in fitted],counts=counts,
                  primary_eligible=all(c['bifolia']>=2 for c in counts.values()),
                  diagnostic_eligible=all(c['folios']>=2 for c in counts.values()))
        assert held.isdisjoint(p['physical'] for p in fitted)
        assert set(ids).isdisjoint(p['id'] for p in fitted)
        result['geometry'].append(geom)
        if not geom['diagnostic_eligible']: continue
        for edition in ('zl','it'):
            train,test=corpus.split_pages('practice',edition)
            index={p.id:p for p in train+test}
            train_layout=[control.eligible_page(index[p['id']]) for p in fitted]
            test_layout=[control.eligible_page(index[x]) for x in ids]
            pools=[('observed',None,train_layout+test_layout)]
            for seed in range(401,407):
                copied=generators.g_self_citation(train_layout,train_layout+test_layout,seed=seed)
                planted,_=control.plant_words(copied,seed)
                pools.extend([('copy',seed,copied),('planted',seed,planted)])
            for case,seed,pages in pools:
                n=len(train_layout);a,b=pages[:n],pages[n:]
                record=dict(pages=ids,edition=edition,scenario=case,generator_seed=seed,
                            tfidf=baseline(a,b),nmf={str(s):control.pair_margin(a,b,s) for s in (47,83,113)})
                result['scores'].append(record)
            print(ids,edition,'completed',flush=True)
    result['primary_eligible_pairs']=sum(x['primary_eligible'] for x in result['geometry'])
    result['diagnostic_pairs']=sum(x['diagnostic_eligible'] for x in result['geometry'])
    result['sha256']={n:hashlib.sha256((HERE/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ('plan.json','run.py','control.py','audit.py')}
    (HERE/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Metadata-only independent physical-support audit; run from repository root."""
import json, re, hashlib
from collections import Counter
from functools import lru_cache
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
from vs import corpus, ivtff

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = Path.cwd()

def collect(part, minimum=40):
    editions = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[part] for e in ('zl','it')}
    it = {p.id:p for p in editions['it']}
    order = list(dict.fromkeys(re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0] for p in corpus.pages('zl')))
    rows = []
    for p in editions['zl']:
        q = it.get(p.id)
        if q is None or (p.hand,p.section,p.language)!=(q.hand,q.section,q.language): continue
        lengths = [sum(not ivtff.uncertain(w) for ln in x.lines if ln.unit=='P' for w in ln.words) for x in (p,q)]
        if min(lengths)<minimum or not p.hand or not p.section: continue
        folio = re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0]
        rows.append(dict(id=p.id,folio=folio,order=order.index(folio),number=int(folio[1:]),hand=p.hand,
                         section=p.section,language=p.language,lengths=lengths,quire=p.meta.get('Q'),
                         bifolio=p.meta.get('B'),physical=(p.meta.get('Q','?')+':'+p.meta.get('B','?'))))
    return rows

def pack(sets):
    sets = tuple(sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in sets}))
    @lru_cache(None)
    def solve(i,used):
        if i==len(sets): return ()
        best=solve(i+1,used)
        if not set(sets[i]) & set(used):
            candidate=(sets[i],)+solve(i+1,tuple(sorted(set(used)|set(sets[i]))))
            if len(candidate)>len(best): best=candidate
        return best
    return solve(0,())

def support(edges):
    pages={p['id']:p for edge in edges for p in edge}
    return dict(comparisons=len(edges),page_sides=len(pages),folios=len({p['folio'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia_per_comparison=dict(Counter(len({p['physical'] for p in edge}) for edge in edges)),
                max_bifolio_disjoint=len(pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                max_quire_disjoint=len(pack([{p['quire'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                witnesses=pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges]))

def match(a,b,distance,ratio):
    return (a['section']==b['section'] and 0<abs(a['order']-b['order'])<=distance
            and all(max(x,y)/min(x,y)<=ratio for x,y in zip(a['lengths'],b['lengths'])))

def main():
    train,test=collect(0),collect(1)
    eligible=lambda rows:[p for p in rows if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','3','5')]
    tr,ev=eligible(train),eligible(test)
    independent={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('local',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        raw=[(a,b) for a,b in combinations(ev,2) if a['hand']!=b['hand'] and match(a,b,dist,ratio)]
        details=[]
        for a,b in raw:
            fit=[p for p in tr if p['quire'] not in (a['quire'],b['quire'])]
            counts={h:len({p['folio'] for p in fit if p['hand']==h}) for h in ('2','5')}
            details.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],bifolia=[a['physical'],b['physical']],training_folios=counts))
        good=[edge for edge,d in zip(raw,details) if min(d['training_folios'].values())>=2]
        independent[name]=dict(raw=support(raw),trainable=support(good),details=details)
    # Reconstruct the original four-folio modulo-four test folds and both Currier-matched rules.
    prior={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('strict',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        edges=[]; overlap=[]; clean_training=[]
        for fold in range(4):
            fit=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4!=fold]
            held=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4==fold]
            for a,b in combinations(held,2):
                if a['hand']==b['hand'] or min(sum(p['hand']==h for p in fit) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand']))<2: continue
                if a['language']!=b['language'] or not match(a,b,dist,ratio): continue
                edges.append((a,b))
                shared={a['physical'],b['physical']} & {p['physical'] for p in fit}
                if shared: overlap.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],shared=sorted(shared)))
                clean=[p for p in fit if p['physical'] not in (a['physical'],b['physical'])]
                clean_training.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],folios_by_hand={h:len({p['folio'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])},bifolia_by_hand={h:sorted({p['physical'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])}))
        prior[name]=dict(support=support(edges),pairs=[[a['id'],b['id']] for a,b in edges],training_overlap=overlap,
                         bifolio_excluded_training=clean_training)
    # Reconstruct prior same-Currier triads under its original numeric-folio 16-leaf blocks.
    tri_docs=collect(0,50); triads=[]; grouped={}
    for a in tri_docs:
        for b in tri_docs:
            for c in tri_docs:
                if len({a['folio'],b['folio'],c['folio']})!=3: continue
                if len({(x['number']-1)//16 for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                if a['hand']!=b['hand'] or a['hand']==c['hand']: continue
                if len({x['section'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1 or len({x['language'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                da,dc=abs(a['number']-b['number']),abs(a['number']-c['number'])
                if max(da,dc)>12 or abs(da-dc)>2: continue
                if any(max(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))/min(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))>1.25 for j in (0,1)): continue
                triads.append((a,b,c));grouped.setdefault(str((a['number']-1)//16),[]).append((a,b,c))
    expected_pairs=json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/K-030-open-1/fleet-sol/step.json').read_text())['practice']['totals']
    pair_counts_match=(prior['strict']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and matched']['pairs']
                       and prior['wide']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and wider match']['pairs'])
    assert pair_counts_match
    assert len(triads)==10
    result=dict(protocol=json.loads((OUT/'plan-independent.json').read_text()),prior_pair_counts_match=pair_counts_match,
                metadata_table_exact_match=json.loads((OUT/'layout-reproduced.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))==json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/P-L2-002/mubadala777/step.json').read_text())['metadata_results'],
                independent_evaluation=ev,independent=independent,prior_pairs=prior,
                prior_triads=dict(support=support(triads),blocks={k:support(v) for k,v in grouped.items()},
                                  rows=[[p['id'] for p in edge] for edge in triads]),
                inventory={h:dict(pages=[p['id'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h],bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h})) for h in ('2','3','5')},
                hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('data/raw/ZL3b-n.txt','data/raw/IT2a-n.txt')})
    (OUT/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': main()
